create_LinearizedConvolution: create a LinearizedConvolution module with specified in_channels, out_channels, and kernel_size for optimized 1D convolution
run_forward_training: run the forward pass of LinearizedConvolution in training mode with Time x Batch x Channel input
run_forward_inference: run the forward pass of LinearizedConvolution in inference mode with incremental_state for one time step generation
review_LinearizedConvolution_state_dict: review the LinearizedConvolution state_dict method to exclude redundant linearized weight from saved checkpoints
test_reorder_incremental_state: test the reorder_incremental_state method to reorder the input buffer by a new batch order tensor
